sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – binding 36-month commitment for full volume
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

We can make a binding commitment for 23,400 seals per year for 36 months, allowing 56 days for delivery. This gives you the longer commitment and scheduling room requested in your capacity letter.

Our September orders for this same seal were at EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). We propose renewing at that price in exchange for the full allocation and the longer commitment above.

Payment remains 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling charge. Can you agree to this complete package?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – binding 36-month commitment for full volume
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Historical prices from September do not reflect our current capacity constraints, and our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month commitment at 23,400 units per year and the 56-day lead time. Based on the increased volume and extended contract term, we can offer a revised price of €31.90 per unit. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – closing proposal: 23,400/yr, 36 months, 56 days
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming full allocation of 23,400 seals per year for 36 months with a 56-day lead time. We appreciate the movement on price.

To close this now, we propose EUR 30.90/unit on exactly those terms:
- 23,400 pcs per year
- 36-month contract
- 56 days lead time
- 30 days net payment, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause, no tooling charge

This gives you a firm three-year full-volume commitment from a long-standing customer, plus the scheduling room you asked for. If you accept this package, we can conclude on these exact terms.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – closing proposal: 23,400/yr, 36 months, 56 days
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can offer EUR 31.60 per unit for the 36-month contract at 23,400 units per year with a 56-day lead time. Lieferzeit is 56 days, for a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a price of €31.60 per unit, and a contract term of 36 months. All deliveries remain strictly subject to our standard conditions.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
